info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Location Call Settings:  Schedules API

params.name: locationId
params.description: Return the list of schedules for this location.

params.name: orgId
params.description: List schedules for this organization.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the number of objects returned to this maximum count.

params.name: start
params.description: Start at the zero-based offset in the list of matching objects.

params.name: name
params.description: Only return schedules with the matching name.

params.name: type
params.description: Type of the schedule.

items.docs:
List all schedules for the given location of the organization.

A time schedule establishes a set of times during the day or holidays in the year in which a feature, for example auto attendants, can perform a specific action.

Retrieving this list requires a full or read-only administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.
